Agent 04/35 — countersteer detection threshold audit. Stress digitalCountersteerRecoveryBlend using yaw rate + body sideslip across stable cornering, chicanes, lift-off rotation, curb strikes and genuine oversteer. Identify false positives/false negatives around 4–14 deg beta and 0.25–0.85 rad/s yaw. Preserve emergency opposite-lock authority without allowing ordinary direction changes to bypass the road-speed envelope. No forces/assists. Add mirrored threshold and full-vehicle oversteer tests if justified.
